GlobalPaymentType.description: The global (platform-level) payment type definition associated with a retailer payment type.

badge.description: URL of the payment type badge image.

category.description: The category of the payment type.

configuration_url.description: URL for configuring this payment type.

description.description: A description of the payment type.

header.description: The display header for the payment type.

internal.description: Indicates if this is an internal payment type.

logo.description: URL of the payment type logo.

name.description: The name of the global payment type.

online_only.description: Indicates if this payment type is available online only.

platforms.description: The platforms on which this payment type is supported.

referred_inactive.description: Indicates if the payment type was referred but is inactive.

show_banner.description: Indicates if a banner should be shown for this payment type.

subcategory.description: The subcategory of the payment type.

subtext.description: Additional display text shown below the payment type name.

config.description: Payment type configuration. Shape varies by payment type.

disabled.description: Indicates if the payment type is disabled.

gateway.description: Indicates if the payment type is a gateway type.

internal.description: Indicates if the payment type is for internal use only.

is_editable.description: Indicates if the payment type can be edited. Omitted when not applicable.

name.description: The name of the payment type.

name_changed_by_user.description: Indicates if the name was customised by the retailer.

outlet_ids.description: The list of outlet IDs this payment type is associated with.

type_id.description: The ID of the global payment type. It shouldn't be used to identify the payment type - there may be multiple payment types with the same `type_id`.

Version.description: An object containing the highest and lowest version numbers for all items of the returned collection.

max.description: Highest version number of the payload, or `null` when the result set is empty.

min.description: Lowest version number of the payload, or `null` when the result set is empty.
